outcome: Need for additional procedures (gauze packing, uterine artery embolization, peripartum hysterectomy)
cohort: 46 patients with postpartum hemorrhage non-responsive to uterotonics treated with balloon tamponade between April 2008 and March 2015 at Rinku General Medical Center
finding: A serum fibrinogen level of 172.5 mg/dL was identified as a cut-off value for predicting successful balloon tamponade in women with postpartum hemorrhage.
